title: Kubernetes Workload Compiler
description: Compiles Kubernetes Deployment, StatefulSet, and DaemonSet manifests. Enforces: selector labels match pod template, every container has image+resources, all configmaps/secrets/serviceaccounts exist or declared, valid rollout strategy.

error_codes.KW001: k8s-workload-spec.json missing or invalid — required: name, kind, image, replicas, ports[]
error_codes.KW002: Selector labels do not match pod template labels
error_codes.KW003: Container missing resource requests or limits
error_codes.KW004: Image reference has no version tag or digest (floating latest)
error_codes.KW005: ConfigMap, Secret, or ServiceAccount referenced but not declared
